owner_rule: 2026-10-18: formed bends >= 10 deg count as bends (was >= 15). A 10-15 deg bend must be a distinct formed fold between two flat plates; gentle rolled-surface kinks, embosses, scan artifacts and springback ripples are not bends.
scope: all 58 GOLD_SET_V1 scans (gold11 + new_gold); read-only on prep/lines/labels/cad_crosscheck; nothing else written
method: Prep = lines.json prep_dir of the latest gold lines dir (gold11: broad_baseline/gold11_audit/relabel/<scan>[_rN]; new_gold: GOLD_SET_V1 lines_dir).

Every adjacent patch pair (patches.json neighbors) with patch-normal angle 2.5-25 deg was run through research.bench_labeling.geometry.compute_bend on points_ds (LineParams(min_support=15), oriented outward normals when available, pairs whose support needed zone expansion dropped, same filter as prep candidate_pairs). Pairs with bend 9-16 deg kept.
Covered by gold = some gold label line within 5 deg axis, median perpendicular distance <= 4 mm (+ t/sin(bend) for mixed-skin pairs) and >= 50% overlap.
Uncovered pairs clustered into folds (parallel <= 5 deg, offset <= max(4, 2t+2) mm, axial gap <= 6 mm: joins outer/inner skin pairs and window-split pieces).

Auto classes: ARC_FACET_OF_GOLD_BEND = a thin strip (< 2t+3 mm) parallel to a gold line with >= 50% overlap within 1.1*(Ri+t)*tan(gold_bend/2)+1.5 mm (first facet of a radiused gold bend); ROLLED_FACET_SEQUENCE = small-angle facets sharing a patch with other parallel small-angle folds offset 2t+1..2.5*width mm (faceted rolled surface).

CAD: cad_crosscheck_auto V10 angles + cad_crosscheck_match per-scan registered CAD bends (V10 and lenient) with CAD angle or scan-measured angle 9-16 deg, mapped by R,t into the scan frame and checked against gold lines and local patches.
Hidden folds: every patch >= 300 points 2-means split on its point normals; reported when the split is 8-18 deg with tight clusters.
Survivors reviewed by cross-section plots and single-skin slope profiles (scratch scripts, not in the repo).
